sections.description:
Wow Elements Addons for Elementor is a comprehensive plugin designed to supercharge your Elementor page builder with powerful, easy-to-use widgets. Perfect for bloggers, marketers, business owners, and WooCommerce users who want to create stunning, fully customized websites.

Why Wow Elements?

  • 120+ Free & Pro widgets to cover common UI patterns
  • Mobile-first, responsive controls
  • WooCommerce widgets(grids, carousels, pricing, reviews)
  • Smooth Animations & Effects
  • Easy Drag & Drop Interface
  • Modern Perfect Design Control
  • Lightweight assets and performance-oriented defaults
  • Pixel-perfect design options
  • Regular updates and friendly support

  • Order Page – Design custom WooCommerce order page with customizable styling
  • Single Product Page – Customize WooCommerce single product page with full design control

🎨 Theme Builder (Header, Footer, Single Post, Archive)

Build custom headers, footers, single post layouts, and archive pages with full Elementor design control. Compatible with popular themes including Astra, GeneratePress, OceanWP, Neve, Genesis, and Beaver Builder Theme.

  • Post Content – Show full post content or excerpts with customizable length and formatting
  • Post Featured Image – Display post featured images with custom dimensions and styling
  • Post Info – Show post metadata including author, date, categories, tags, and comments count
  • Post Comments – Display post comments section with customizable styling and layout

🛒 Single Product Builder Widgets

  • Product Title – Display and style WooCommerce product titles with custom typography
  • Product Image – Show product images with gallery support and zoom functionality
  • Product Price – Display product pricing with sale price highlighting and custom styling
  • Product Rating – Show product star ratings with customizable colors and sizes
  • Product Description – Display full or short product descriptions with formatting options
  • Product Meta – Show product metadata including SKU, categories, and tags
  • Product Stock – Display product stock status with customizable messages and styling
  • Product Tabs – Show product information in organized tabbed layout
  • Product Related – Display related products with grid or carousel layout
  • Add to Cart – Customizable add to cart button with quantity selector and styling options
  • Additional Information – Display product attributes and additional details in table format
  • Call For Price – Show custom call for price message when product price is not set

🌀 Elementor Extend Features

  • Grid Line – Add decorative grid lines and layout guides to enhance visual structure
  • Wrapper Link – Make any container or section clickable with custom link functionality
  • Animated Gradient Background – Apply animated gradient backgrounds to sections and containers
  • Backdrop Filter – Add blur, brightness, and filter effects to element backgrounds
  • Liquid Glass Effects – Create modern glassmorphism effects with customizable blur and transparency
  • Adblock Detector – Detect ad blockers and display custom messages to users

More widgets and features are coming soon…
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload wow-elements-addons-for-elementor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Start using it by going to the Elementor editor.
sections.faq:
Does your plugin support all WordPress themes?

  • Yes, the Wow Elements Addons for Elementor is compatible and supports all WordPress themes including popular free and premium Elementor themes.

What do I need to use the plugin?

  • Just install Wow Elements Addons for Elementor along with Elementor page builder; that’s all. Our plugin will provide you with all essential widgets to help you create your blogging site in minutes.

Do you provide tutorials on the plugin?

  • Of course, we provide detailed documentation and video to support our users with thorough guidelines for our plugins and widgets.

How do I get a solution for any issue?

  • Just contact us and we will follow up within 24 hours with our expert technical team.

How should I get updates and support

  • When we release a update version, then automatically you will get a notification on WordPress plugin manager, so you can update from there. Thereafter you want to update manually just knock us, we will send you update version via mail.
